title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 20
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'plan preparation' for mines includes
options: Drawing plans from survey data at specified scale
questions.solution: Plan preparation involves drawing from survey data.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety officer in a mine is responsible for
options: Safety inspections, investigations, training, and promotion of safety culture
questions.solution: Safety inspections, investigations, training, and promoting safety culture.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must check the correct functioning of
options: Safety devices, supports, and ventilation in his area
questions.solution: Safety devices, supports, and ventilation must all be checked.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The fire drill in a mine must be conducted
options: At regular intervals as prescribed by the manager
questions.solution: At regular intervals as prescribed by the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue base' in mine emergencies is established
options: At a safe location near the mine entrance
questions.solution: Rescue base is established at a safe location near entrance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A '3D laser scanning' in mine surveying is used to
options: Create accurate 3D models of mine surfaces and openings
questions.solution: Creates accurate 3D models of surfaces and openings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'heaving energy' of explosives is important for
questions.solution: Heaving energy displaces fragmented rock for efficient loading.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'subsidence control' through stowing depends on
options: Stowing ratio, material properties, and goaf conditions
questions.solution: Subsidence control depends on ratio, material, and goaf conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'reduction of levels' in surveying is done to
options: Determine the elevation of points relative to a datum
questions.solution: Determine elevation of points relative to a datum.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'shotcrete' in drift support is
questions.solution: Shotcrete is sprayed concrete for immediate support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bench drainage' system must prevent
questions.solution: Bench drainage prevents water accumulation and instability.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support capacity' depends on
options: Material properties, dimensions, and installation quality
questions.solution: Support capacity depends on material, dimensions, and installation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue team leader' must have
options: Rescue team leader certification and experience
questions.solution: Team leaders need certification and experience.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'five-day accident investigation report' must be submitted
questions.solution: Within 5 days of the accident.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'collar pipe' in drifting prevents
options: Collapse of the borehole collar area
questions.solution: Collar pipes prevent borehole collar collapse.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: When a man riding system breaks down, the operator must
options: Arrange alternative safe means of transport or evacuation
questions.solution: Alternative safe transport or evacuation must be arranged.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'support failure report' should include
options: Location, type of support failed, likely cause, and immediate action taken
questions.solution: Location, type, cause, and immediate action.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing thickness' in the goaf determines
options: The degree of ground support and subsidence control
questions.solution: Degree of ground support and subsidence control.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system using a locomotive must have
questions.solution: Automatic couplers and safety bars are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'emergency oxygen supply' for mine rescue must be
options: Sufficient for at least 2 hours of operation
questions.solution: Sufficient for at least 2 hours of operation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'chain pillar' in longwall mining is the
options: Pillar between two adjacent longwall panels
questions.solution: Pillar between two adjacent panels.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'dozer push' is used for
questions.solution: Dozer push is efficient for short-distance movement.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'development headings' in bord and pillar are driven to
options: Create access to the coal panel and form pillars
questions.solution: Create access and form pillars.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A serious accident must be reported to the Chief Inspector within
questions.solution: Within 24 hours.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'auxiliary fan' in mine ventilation is used to
options: Provide additional ventilation to specific areas
questions.solution: Provides additional ventilation to specific areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire hose reel' in mines must be
questions.solution: Fire hose reels must be accessible and regularly tested.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'intake air' in a mine ventilation system refers to
options: Fresh air entering the mine from the surface
questions.solution: Fresh air entering the mine from the surface.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'shield' support in longwall mining protects against
options: Goaf material falling onto the working face
questions.solution: Shields protect the working face from goaf material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support density' in underground mines is determined by
options: Roof conditions, span, and depth of cover
questions.solution: Support density depends on roof conditions, span, and depth.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The minimum percentage of incombustible content required in roadways to prevent coal dust explosion propagation is
questions.solution: Minimum 65% incombustible content is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that the lighting in the working place
questions.solution: Adequate lighting for safe working is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'mine plan' shows
options: All working areas, benches, ramps, dumps, infrastructure
questions.solution: Mine plans show all operational areas and infrastructure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding engine must be stopped if
options: There is any unusual noise or vibration
questions.solution: Must be stopped for any unusual noise or vibration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'profile leveling' determines
questions.solution: Profile leveling determines elevations along a line.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Pit dewatering involves
options: Removing groundwater for dry working conditions
questions.solution: Dewatering removes groundwater for safe working.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'post-blast muck pile' analysis helps to
options: Assess blast effectiveness and optimize future blasts
questions.solution: Muck pile analysis assesses fragmentation and blast performance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The permissible earth leakage setting for circuits in coal mines is
options: As prescribed by regulations, typically 30 mA for portable equipment
questions.solution: Typically 30 mA for portable equipment as per regulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'shotcrete' application in a drift is used to
options: Provide surface support and seal the rock face
questions.solution: Provides surface support and seals the rock face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The live-line working in mines is
options: Generally prohibited except under special circumstances
questions.solution: Generally prohibited except under special circumstances.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'through ventilation' in mines means
options: Air passing from intake to return through working areas
Provide fresh air to working faces
questions.solution: Through ventilation passes air from intake to return through working areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'distribution list' of a report should include
questions.solution: Only relevant persons as per reporting requirements.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue team training' covers
options: Gas detection, casualty handling, fire fighting, communication
questions.solution: Training covers detection, handling, fighting, communication.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'chock' in underground mining is used to
options: Support the roof with high load capacity
questions.solution: Chocks provide high-capacity roof support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety factor of a rope used for man riding must not be less than
questions.solution: The safety factor must not be less than 6.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'dragline' in opencast mining is used for
options: Removing overburden from above mineral deposit
questions.solution: Draglines are large machines for overburden removal.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In coal mines, the maximum permissible explosive charge per shot is limited to prevent
questions.solution: Charge limits prevent ignition of methane-air mixtures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation records' must include
options: Air quantity, quality, and fan performance data
questions.solution: Records must include quantity, quality, fan performance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Continuous miners are used in
options: Room and pillar operations for coal extraction
questions.solution: Continuous miners are used in room and pillar for coal extraction.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'regulator' in ventilation is used to
options: Control air quantity through an airway
questions.solution: Regulators control air quantity through airways.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A coal dust explosion is more likely in roadways that are
options: Dry and have accumulated coal dust
questions.solution: Dry roadways with accumulated coal dust are more likely.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'objective' of an accident report is to
options: Present facts and findings to prevent recurrence
questions.solution: Present facts and findings to prevent recurrence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'in situ' theory of coal formation suggests
options: Coal formed from plants growing in place
questions.solution: In situ theory suggests coal formed from plants growing in place.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The gravimetric sampling for coal dust is done using
options: A pre-weighed filter in a sampling head
questions.solution: A pre-weighed filter in a sampling head is used.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gas chromatography' in mines is used to
questions.solution: Gas chromatography identifies and measures gas composition.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ribs' in bord and pillar mining are
options: The sides of pillars that support the roof
questions.solution: Sides of pillars supporting the roof.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'barrier pillar' between two workings is used to
options: Prevent water from one area inundating the other
questions.solution: Prevents water from one area inundating the other.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'road condition monitoring' includes
options: Regular checking of surface, drainage, signage
questions.solution: Road monitoring checks surface, drainage, signage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The water level in the sump must be monitored by
options: The person in charge of pumping arrangements
questions.solution: By the person in charge of pumping arrangements.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fixed carbon' in coal is
options: The solid carbon remaining after volatile matter is released
questions.solution: Fixed carbon is solid carbon remaining after volatiles.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The use of water for extinguishing an underground fire must be
options: Controlled to prevent electrical hazards and flooding
questions.solution: Controlled to prevent electrical hazards and flooding.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding rope must be discarded if
options: It shows signs of deterioration or damage beyond limits
questions.solution: Must be discarded if deterioration or damage exceeds limits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The DGMS stands for
questions.solution: Directorate General of Mine Safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ram' in a hydraulic roof support is used to
options: Advance the support towards the face
questions.solution: Rams advance the support towards the working face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'coal fire' in an open cast mine can be caused by
options: Improper handling of explosives, equipment heat, or spontaneous combustion
questions.solution: Improper handling of explosives, equipment heat, or spontaneous combustion.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'methane gas' in a mine can contribute to fire because
options: It is explosive when mixed with air in certain proportions
questions.solution: Explosive when mixed with air in certain proportions.

questions.stem: A man riding system on a slope must have
questions.solution: An anti-rollback device.

questions.solution: Coalification involves both biological and geological processes.

questions.stem: The 'bolt pattern' in roof support is determined by
options: Roof conditions, span, and loading requirements
questions.solution: Bolt patterns are determined by conditions, span, and loading.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'haulage' in underground mines refers to
options: Transport of coal and materials from face to surface
questions.solution: Haulage is the transport of coal and materials.

questions.stem: The condition for approaching water-logged workings under CMR 2017 requires

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'differential leveling' determines
questions.solution: Differential leveling determines height differences.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'explosion prevention' in coal mines includes
options: Ventilation, gas monitoring, and ignition source control
questions.solution: Prevention includes ventilation, monitoring, ignition control.

questions.stem: The maximum gradient for a man riding incline system is

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must not be used if
options: Any defect is found that affects safety
questions.solution: Use must stop if any safety defect is found.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The fire-fighting equipment in a mine must include

questions.solution: Fire extinguishers, sand buckets, hose pipes, and water supply.

questions.stem: The 'angle of draw' refers to

questions.solution: Angle of draw defines lateral extent of surface subsidence.

questions.stem: The 'shot hole' in underground coal mines is drilled at

questions.solution: Shot holes are drilled at predetermined angles and depths.

questions.stem: The 'stowing certificate' in a mine certifies that

questions.solution: Stowing carried out as per approved plan.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The permissible limit for quartz content in coal mine dust is
questions.solution: The permissible quartz content limit is 5%.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding engine must not be operated by a person who
options: Is under the influence of intoxicants
questions.solution: Persons under the influence of intoxicants must not operate winding engines.
